options.renderScaleHint: Scale the current quality's canvas resolution to 100, 85, 75 or 50 percent. Lower values reduce drawing work but soften the image. Gameplay and records are unchanged.
options.backgroundFpsHint: Limit only the animated menu background. Follow quality or choose 60, 30, 15 or 5 FPS. Has no effect while background animation is disabled.
options.frameLimitHint: Frames drawn per second at most. Lower it to reduce CPU/GPU load and heat on laptops. Unlimited follows the display refresh rate. Gameplay, collisions and records are unaffected.
options.autoQualityHint: When play stays below 75% of the target frame rate (up to 60 FPS), lower quality along with render scale, frame limits and effects. Never raises quality or re-enables disabled effects. Gameplay and records are unaffected.
options.autoQualityLowered: Graphics quality lowered to {level}, with resolution, frame limits and effects adjusted too. Change these in Options → Graphics.
options.antialiasHint: Off: images and the game canvas are scaled to the nearest pixel instead of smoothly, for crisp pixels and a little less work. Edges of shapes and text stay smooth (the browser always draws them that way).
options.shadowsHint: Drop shadows under walls, coins, badges, banners and menu buttons. Turn off for a flatter look and slightly less work.
options.transparencyHint: See-through menu panels and tiles. Turn off to draw them opaque, with less blending over the moving background.
device.title: Set up for this device?
device.body: Avoid N Survive can check this device and pick graphics options that run smoothly on it.
device.items: Checked: CPU cores, approximate memory, graphics card name, screen resolution, touch screen, and the system's reduce-motion setting.
device.privacy: This stays in your browser and is never sent anywhere. You can change every option later in Options → Graphics.
device.applied: All graphics options set for this device (quality: {level}). Slow play triggers further reductions. Adjust in Options → Graphics.
device.autoHint: Use CPU, memory, GPU and resolution to reset quality, render scale, game and background FPS, shadows, antialiasing, transparency, trails and effects. Missing information uses conservative settings; reduced motion is respected. Nothing leaves your browser.
options.lowSpecHint: Low graphics, automatic input polling, simulation savings, debug off and all four cosmetic effects off. Adjust each option here or use Reset to restore defaults.
options.trailHint: Turn off to skip recording and drawing cursor trails.
options.effectsHint: Turn off death particles and flying coin effects. Hazards remain visible.
options.backgroundHint: Turn off the menu demo and its background simulation.
options.interfaceHint: Turn off interface blur and shadows.
options.fpsHint: Show the frame rate in the corner of the play screen.
options.debugHint: Show sample interval and polling rate below the game.
options.pollingHint: Mouse samples used per second while playing. Lower it if a high-polling-rate mouse makes the game stutter. Records are still timed to the millisecond.
options.graphicsHint: Rendering resolution and menu background frame rate. Lower it on slow computers or 4K screens. Gameplay and records are unaffected.
options.languageReload: The game reloads to switch the language.
debug.title: Debug
debug.help: Keep moving the mouse to measure the real sample interval. A 1000Hz mouse should show about 1.000ms, a typical 125Hz mouse about 8ms. Hit detection splits the path between samples at every 1ms boundary and checks it with continuous collision detection.
